d: We are looking for an IT Executive Specialist to support the configuration, testing, deployment readiness, and technical support of Snoonu Charge stations. The role will primarily focus on pre-deployment station configuration and technical readiness, while also providing technical assistance to the deployment team and supporting post-deployment troubleshooting.
q: 3+ years of experience in IT service support or a related role.
Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and IT service management.
Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools for logging and resolving requests.
Proven troubleshooting ability for moderately complex IT issues.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Familiarity with Notion, Slack, Miro, or similar collaboration tools.
ITIL Foundation, Network+, MCSA, or CCNA certification.
Experience supporting hybrid or multi-office teams.

r: Provide Tier 1-2 technical support to employees via phone, portal, and remote tools.
Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware and software systems.
Assist in the design and implementation of networks, Wi-Fi, and LAN connectivity.
Consult with users on hardware/software needs and deliver training on new tools.
Maintain accurate IT asset inventories in coordination with IT Coordinators.
Build and maintain technical documentation and knowledge-base articles.
Support small-scale technology rollouts under senior guidance.
Escalate complex issues to senior IT staff with clear context and troubleshooting history.
